scenes.picture: In front of a tall hedge maze, a goofy crow flaps down with news, and a child in a new magic cape taps a leafy gate that swings open.

sentences.text: Gus came with a spell.
The maze has a big gate.
The gate will not shake.
The cap is a cape!
The gate swung back.

scenes.picture: In a hedge maze, a white kite is stuck at the top of a pine tree, a bouncy boy jumps for it and a cheerful boy floats it down.

sentences.text: A white kite is in a pine.
Chip hops, but it is up top.
Up, up! Bix lifts the kite.
The spell is on the kite!
Whiz! Off it went in the wind.

scenes.picture: In a hedge maze, a silly queen reaches for a kite with a long pole and a coil of rope, while a goofy crow tells her a joke and the pole snaps.

sentences.text: Vex has a rope and a pole.
Vex can get it with the pole.
Gus has a joke for Vex.
Vex broke the pole!
The kite rose up and up.

scenes.picture: Through a hole in a hedge, a cute mule plays a silver flute, and a white kite drifts down beside it while a baby claps.

sentences.text: Here is a hole in the maze.
A cute mule is in the maze.
The mule has a flute.
The mule can hum a tune.
The kite fell on the mule.

scenes.picture: In a hedge maze, a row of little gray mice carry a loose page away, spinning in circles, while a little kitten in a wizard hat races after them.

sentences.text: Nice mice race in a line.
The mice have the spell!
Twice the mice spin in place.
The cat will race the mice.

scenes.picture: In a hedge maze, a silly queen guards a huge gold birdcage with a page inside, a girl with two hair buns shrinks it, and a baby hugs the queen.

sentences.text: Vex hid the spell in a cage.
Tess can make the cage shrink.
We got the spell!
Nell will give Vex a hug.
Come and get some cake!

side.picture: In a hedge maze, a baby whooshes down a little slide again and again with a kitten in a wizard hat riding in her lap.

sentences.text: Nell is on the slide.
Nell slid and slid!
Nell will ride with the cat.
The cat slid on the slide.

side.picture: In the shade of a hedge, a very big sleepy cat naps on a flat stone by a garden gate, and does not wake up at all.

sentences.text: Thud is in the shade.
Thud woke and came to the gate.
Thud has a nap on a stone.
Thud did not wake up.
